subject: DI01000081

body.en:
Understand the idea

Charge q is a property of matter measured in coulombs.Current is the rate at which net charge crosses a section:I=dq/dt.

Explanation and application

  • Positive conventional current follows positive-charge motion;in a metal electrons drift oppositely.Current is not consumed by a resistor;energy is transferred.
  • For constant current,Q=It;1A=1C/s.DC has a fixed reference polarity/direction;its magnitude need not always be perfectly constant.
  • For uniform flow normal to area A,current density J=I/A in A/m².In general current density is a vector and I is its area integral.
  • A closed conducting path and a maintained potential difference allow sustained conduction;an open ideal path can have voltage without current.
Does a resistor consume current?

No.Charge continuity remains;electrical energy is converted.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

વિદ્યુતભાર q પદાર્થનો ગુણધર્મ છે અને coulombમાં મપાય છે.છેદમાંથી એકમ સમયમાં પસાર થતો net charge એટલે current:I=dq/dt.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Conventional currentની દિશા positive chargeની ગતિ પ્રમાણે છે;metalમાં electrons વિરુદ્ધ drift કરે છે.Resistor current વાપરી નાખતો નથી,પણ energyનું રૂપાંતર કરે છે.
  • Constant current માટે Q=It;1A=1C/s.DCની reference polarity/direction સ્થિર હોય છે,પરંતુ magnitude હંમેશાં બિલકુલ constant હોવું જરૂરી નથી.
  • Area A પર uniform normal flow માટે J=I/A અને unit A/m² છે.સામાન્ય સ્થિતિમાં current density vector છે અને area પર તેના flowથી I મળે છે.
  • બંધ conducting path અને maintained potential differenceથી સતત conduction થાય છે.Open ideal pathમાં current વગર voltage હોઈ શકે છે.
Resistor Current વાપરી નાખે છે?

ના.Charge continuity જળવાય છે;electrical energyનું રૂપાંતર થાય છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Electric potential is energy per unit charge relative to a reference;voltage is the difference between two potentials:V=W/Q.

Explanation and application

  • One volt equals one joule per coulomb.The reference node is a chosen zero,not necessarily physical earth.
  • EMF describes energy supplied per unit charge by a source;despite its name it is not a mechanical force.
  • A real cell has internal resistance r.Under discharge with the stated polarity,terminal V=E−Ir;at open circuit I≈0 gives V≈E in the simple model.
  • Connect a voltmeter across the two nodes of interest;its input resistance should be high enough not to significantly load the circuit.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Reference સામે chargeદીઠ energy એટલે potential;બે potentialsનો તફાવત voltage છે:V=W/Q.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • One volt એટલે one joule per coulomb.Reference nodeને zero પસંદ કરીએ છીએ;તે physical earth જ હોય એવું જરૂરી નથી.
  • EMF source દ્વારા chargeદીઠ અપાતી energy દર્શાવે છે;નામમાં force હોવા છતાં તે mechanical force નથી.
  • Real cellમાં internal resistance r હોય છે.Dischargeમાં stated polarity માટે terminal V=E−Ir;simple modelમાં open circuit I≈0 હોય તો V≈E.
  • Voltmeter સંબંધિત બે nodes વચ્ચે parallel જોડાય છે.તેનું input resistance એટલું મોટું હોવું જોઈએ કે circuitમાં નોંધપાત્ર loading ન થાય.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Resistance R relates terminal voltage and current at the specified operating state;resistivity rho describes the material rather than a particular component shape.

Explanation and application

  • Uniform conductor:R=rho l/A.R is in ohms,rho in ohm-metres,l in metres and A in m².Double length doubles R;double area halves R if rho stays unchanged.
  • Conductance G=1/R in siemens;conductivity sigma=1/rho in S/m.G depends on geometry as well as material.
  • Material,length,area,temperature and physical condition affect resistance;contact resistance is additional to an ideal uniform-wire calculation.
  • Diameter is not area.For a circular wire A=pi d²/4;doubling diameter quadruples area and quarters R under the same assumptions.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Specified operating stateમાં R voltage-currentનો સંબંધ બતાવે છે;resistivity rho ચોક્કસ componentના shapeને બદલે materialનો ગુણધર્મ દર્શાવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Uniform conductor માટે R=rho l/A.Rની unit ohm,rhoની ohm-metre,lની metre અને Aની m² છે.Rho unchanged હોય તો length બમણી કરતાં R બમણું અને area બમણું કરતાં અડધું થાય છે.
  • Conductance G=1/R ની unit siemens અને conductivity sigma=1/rho ની unit S/m છે.G material સાથે geometry પર પણ આધારિત છે.
  • Material,length,area,temperature તથા physical condition resistance બદલે છે.Ideal wire calculation ઉપરાંત contact resistance પણ હોઈ શકે છે.
  • Diameter અને area સમાન નથી.Circular wire માટે A=pi d²/4;સમાન ધારણાઓમાં diameter બમણો કરતાં area ચાર ગણો અને R ચોથો ભાગ થાય છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative uniform wire:rho=1.7×10⁻⁸ohm m,l=10m,A=1mm² at the specified reference temperature.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=1×10⁻⁶m²
  2. R=(1.7×10⁻⁸×10)/(1×10⁻⁶)=0.17ohm
  3. For a10m outgoing plus10m return conductor,the same-area loop resistance is0.34ohm before contacts.

Interpretation and check

Always state whether length means one conductor or the whole return loop.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Illustrative uniform wire માટે reference temperatureએ rho=1.7×10⁻⁸ohm m,l=10m,A=1mm² લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. A=1×10⁻⁶m²
  2. R=(1.7×10⁻⁸×10)/(1×10⁻⁶)=0.17ohm
  3. 10m outgoing અને10m return બન્ને ગણતાં same-area loop resistance contacts પહેલાં0.34ohm થાય છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Length એક conductorની છે કે આખા return loopની તે સ્પષ્ટ લખો.

h.en: Resistor types:choose by behaviour and rating
h.gu: Resistorના Types:Behaviour અને Rating પ્રમાણે પસંદગી

body.en:
Understand the idea

Resistance is a property;practical resistor constructions differ in stability,power,adjustability and dependence on the environment.

Explanation and application

  • Carbon-film/carbon-composition:resistive carbon-based path between terminals;general use depends on tolerance,noise and power rating.
  • Metal-film:thin resistive film on an insulating body;often chosen for stable,low-noise precision service when specified ratings fit.
  • Wire-wound:resistance wire on an insulated former;useful for suitable power duties,but winding inductance may limit high-frequency use.
  • Potentiometer:three-terminal track/wiper used as a voltage divider.Rheostat connection uses a wiper and one end as a variable resistance;wiper current limits still apply.
  • Thermistor/LDR:resistance deliberately varies with temperature/light;do not assume a constant R across changing conditions.NTC decreases R with rising temperature in its specified range.
  • Power rating is permissible dissipation under stated mounting/temperature conditions,not a promise that every similarly sized resistor has the same rating.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Resistance ગુણધર્મ છે;practical resistor constructions stability,power,adjustment તથા environment-dependenceમાં જુદાં હોય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Carbon-film/compositionમાં terminals વચ્ચે carbon-based resistive path હોય છે.General use tolerance,noise તથા power rating મુજબ થાય છે.
  • Metal-filmમાં insulating body ઉપર thin resistive film હોય છે.Ratings યોગ્ય હોય તો stable,low-noise precision useમાં પસંદ થાય છે.
  • Wire-woundમાં insulated former ઉપર resistance wire હોય છે.Suitable power dutiesમાં ઉપયોગી છે,પણ inductanceથી high-frequency use મર્યાદિત થઈ શકે છે.
  • Potentiometerમાં three-terminal track/wiper voltage divider બને છે.Rheostatમાં wiper અને એક endથી variable R મળે છે;wiper current limit જાળવવી પડે છે.
  • Thermistor/LDRમાં temperature/lightથી R બદલાય છે.Changing conditionsમાં constant R ન માનો.NTCમાં specified rangeમાં temperature વધતાં R ઘટે છે.
  • Power rating stated mounting/temperature conditions માટે permissible dissipation છે.Same size એટલે same rating એવું નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Classification concerns available charge carriers and their mobility,not a claim that any material has exactly zero or infinite resistance.

Explanation and application

  • Conductors such as copper have many mobile carriers.Metal resistance normally rises with temperature because scattering increases.
  • Semiconductor conductivity depends strongly on doping,temperature and illumination;in common intrinsic cases increasing temperature increases carriers and reduces resistance.
  • Insulators resist conduction but can leak or break down at excessive electric field;do not equate an insulating label with unlimited voltage safety.
  • For a limited range with an approximately constant coefficient,R(T)=R0[1+alpha0(T−T0)].The alpha0 coefficient refers to T0 and is not universal for all materials/ranges.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

આ વર્ગીકરણ ઉપલબ્ધ charge carriers અને તેમની mobility પર આધારિત છે;કોઈ materialનું R ચોક્કસ zero અથવા infinite છે એવો અર્થ નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Copper જેવા conductorsમાં ઘણા mobile carriers હોય છે.Temperature વધતાં scattering વધવાથી metalનું resistance સામાન્ય રીતે વધે છે.
  • Semiconductorમાં doping,temperature અને light conductivityને અસર કરે છે.Common intrinsic સ્થિતિમાં temperatureથી carriers વધતાં resistance ઘટે છે.
  • Insulators conduction રોકે છે,પણ excessive fieldમાં leakage/breakdown થઈ શકે છે.Insulator છે એટલે unlimited voltage safe એવું નથી.
  • મર્યાદિત rangeમાં coefficient લગભગ constant હોય તો R(T)=R0[1+alpha0(T−T0)].Alpha0 reference T0 માટે છે;દરેક material/range માટે universal નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

R20=10ohm,alpha20=0.004/°C;assume the linear model from20°C to70°C.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Delta T=70−20=50°C
  2. R70=10[1+0.004×50]=12ohm

Interpretation and check

Positive alpha gives increased resistance;do not substitute absolute temperature for temperature rise.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

R20=10ohm,alpha20=0.004/°C;20°Cથી70°C સુધી linear model માનીએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Delta T=70−20=50°C
  2. R70=10[1+0.004×50]=12ohm

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Positive alphaથી resistance વધે છે.Temperature riseની જગ્યાએ absolute temperature ન મૂકો.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

For an ohmic conductor at unchanged physical conditions,V is proportional to I,so V=IR with constant R.

How to apply it

  1. Identify the resistor voltage and current references,not merely the source rating.
  2. Use consistent units and rearrange for the unknown:V=IR,I=V/R,R=V/I.
  3. Check the operating point against resistor power/temperature limits;self-heating may change R.

Validity and common mistakes

  • A straight V-I line through origin at fixed conditions characterises an ideal ohmic resistor.R=V/I at one point alone does not prove linearity.
  • Diodes,electrolytes and strongly heating filaments need their own models;do not apply a constant-R Ohm model blindly.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Physical conditions unchanged હોય તેવા ohmic conductorમાં V અને I proportional હોય છે;તેથી constant R સાથે V=IR.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Resistor ઉપરનો voltage તથા તેની current reference ઓળખો;ફક્ત source rating ન લો.
  2. Consistent units સાથે unknown માટે V=IR,I=V/R અથવા R=V/I વાપરો.
  3. Operating point resistorના power/temperature limitsમાં છે તે તપાસો;self-heatingથી R બદલાઈ શકે છે.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Fixed conditionsમાં originમાંથી પસાર થતી straight V-I line ideal ohmic resistor દર્શાવે છે.એક pointએ R=V/I મળવાથી linearity prove થતી નથી.
  • Diodes,electrolytes અને વધારે ગરમ થતા filaments માટે યોગ્ય models જોઈએ;constant-R model અંધપણે ન લગાડો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative12V source across a constant6ohm load.

Step-by-step solution

  1. I=V/R=12/6=2A
  2. P=VI=12×2=24W
  3. P=I²R=2²×6=24W

Interpretation and check

A small low-power resistor cannot safely dissipate this load;this is a calculation,not a breadboard build recommendation.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Illustrative12V sourceને constant6ohm load સાથે model કરીએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. I=V/R=12/6=2A
  2. P=VI=12×2=24W
  3. P=I²R=2²×6=24W

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

નાનો low-power resistor આ load સુરક્ષિત રીતે dissipate કરી શકતો નથી.આ calculation છે,breadboard build recommendation નથી.

h.gu: Power દર છે;Energy એકત્ર થાય છે

body.en:
Understand the idea

Electrical work transfers energy:W=QV.Power is its rate,P=dW/dt=VI under the chosen terminal references.

Explanation and application

  • Passive sign convention:if current enters the positive terminal,p=vi is absorbed power.A negative result means the element supplies power relative to those references.
  • For constant DC over time t,E=Pt=VIt;1W=1J/s and1kWh=3.6×10⁶J.Wh is energy,not power.
  • For a resistor,P=I²R=V²/R.Battery capacity in Ah measures charge;energy in Wh also depends on voltage and discharge behaviour.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Electrical workથી energy transfer થાય છે:W=QV.Power તેનો સમયદીઠ દર છે:P=dW/dt=VI,chosen terminal references મુજબ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Passive sign conventionમાં current positive terminalમાં પ્રવેશે તો p=vi absorbed power છે.Negative result element energy આપે છે તે બતાવે છે.
  • Constant DC માટે E=Pt=VIt;1W=1J/s અને1kWh=3.6×10⁶J.Wh energy છે,power નથી.
  • Resistor માટે P=I²R=V²/R.Batteryની Ah capacity charge દર્શાવે છે;Wh energy માટે voltage અને discharge behaviour પણ જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative100W load runs3h;assume constant power and a hypothetical tariff of Rs6/kWh.

Step-by-step solution

  1. E=0.100×3=0.300kWh
  2. E=300Wh=1.08×10⁶J
  3. Energy-only cost=0.300×6=Rs1.80

Interpretation and check

This excludes fixed charges/taxes and is not a current electricity-price claim.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Illustrative100W load3h ચાલે છે;constant power અને hypothetical tariff Rs6/kWh માનીએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. E=0.100×3=0.300kWh
  2. E=300Wh=1.08×10⁶J
  3. Energy-only cost=0.300×6=Rs1.80

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આમાં fixed charges/taxes નથી અને actual current tariffનો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

For constant current and resistance over t,H=I²Rt joules;resistive electrical energy becomes heat.

How to apply it

  1. Find actual current through the resistance and convert time to seconds for joules.
  2. Calculate heating with I²Rt;for varying conditions use the time integral of i²R rather than a constant-value shortcut.
  3. Compare heating with cooling and permissible temperature;power alone does not predict final temperature.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Uses include heating elements and fuses;undesired examples are cable/contact losses.Fuse action also depends on thermal design and time-current behaviour.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

સમય t દરમિયાન I અને R constant હોય તો H=I²Rt joule;resistive electrical energy heatમાં ફેરવાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Resistanceમાંથી વહેતો actual current શોધો અને joule માટે સમય secondsમાં ફેરવો.
  2. I²Rtથી heating ગણો;conditions બદલાતી હોય તો constant-value shortcutને બદલે i²Rનું time integral જોઈએ.
  3. Heatingને cooling અને permissible temperature સાથે compare કરો;ફક્ત powerથી final temperature નક્કી થતું નથી.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Heating elements અને fusesમાં આ ઉપયોગી છે;cable/contact lossesમાં અનિચ્છિત છે.Fuse action thermal design તથા time-current behaviour પર પણ આધારિત છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

I=0.5A,R=20ohm,t=120s;assume constant values.

Step-by-step solution

  1. P=I²R=0.5²×20=5W
  2. H=5×120=600J

Interpretation and check

Doubling current quadruples heating power when R is unchanged;do not construct a mains heater from this example.

At fixed R,what happens to heating power when I doubles?

It quadruples because P=I²R.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

I=0.5A,R=20ohm,t=120s;values constant માનીએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. P=I²R=0.5²×20=5W
  2. H=5×120=600J

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

R unchanged હોય ત્યારે current બમણો કરતાં heating power ચાર ગણું થાય છે.આ example પરથી mains heater ન બનાવવો.

Fixed Rમાં I બમણો થાય તો Heating Power?

P=I²R મુજબ ચાર ગણું થાય છે.

body.en:
Aim

Identify resistor types/ratings and compare nominal resistance with an actual measurement.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Known resistor samples,data sheets/colour-code chart and suitable resistance range.

Connections and terminal roles

With all power removed,measure an isolated resistor or lift one lead when an in-circuit parallel path would affect the result.

Supervised procedure

  1. Identify fixed/variable type,printed value or colour bands and tolerance without guessing an unreadable code.
  2. Inspect for heat damage and record the rated power from a reliable marking/data sheet.
  3. Isolate the sample and confirm no applied or residual voltage.
  4. Select ohm mode/range and check lead/contact contribution as the meter manual allows.
  5. Measure with firm contacts;avoid touching both conductors when measuring high resistance.
  6. Repeat if needed and compare actual value with the nominal tolerance interval.

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Known resistor samples,data sheets/colour-code chart and suitable resistance range.

Connections and terminal roles

With all power removed,measure an isolated resistor or lift one lead when an in-circuit parallel path would affect the result.

Supervised procedure

  1. Identify fixed/variable type,printed value or colour bands and tolerance without guessing an unreadable code.
  2. Inspect for heat damage and record the rated power from a reliable marking/data sheet.
  3. Isolate the sample and confirm no applied or residual voltage.
  4. Select ohm mode/range and check lead/contact contribution as the meter manual allows.
  5. Measure with firm contacts;avoid touching both conductors when measuring high resistance.
  6. Repeat if needed and compare actual value with the nominal tolerance interval.

Calculation and conclusion

Fault finding

  • Unstable reading:check contacts,contamination and correct range with power removed.
  • Too low in-circuit reading:look for parallel paths before calling the resistor faulty.

Safety

body.en:
Aim

Check proportional V-I behaviour of a suitable resistor at approximately constant temperature.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.

Connections and terminal roles

Ammeter in series with the resistor;voltmeter across it,not across the ammeter alone.Respect polarity.

Supervised procedure

  1. Choose a rated resistor and approved test-voltage span;calculate worst-case I and P.
  2. With source isolated,assemble the circuit and obtain a supervisor connection check.
  3. Set correct meter sockets/modes and a safe initial source setting/current limit.
  4. Energise only after approval and collect actual V,I pairs over the permitted span.
  5. Watch for heating and allow approved cooling;do not force current to achieve a desired graph.
  6. Isolate power,plot V against I and compare slope/R ratios within measurement limits.

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

For a V-versus-I graph,slope=R.Consistent linearity supports the model over the tested span;one point is not proof.

Fault finding

  • Zero current:power off and check open leads,fuse and series path.
  • Changing V/I:check heating,contact changes,meter loading or a non-ohmic sample.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.

  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.

Connections અને Terminals

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. Rated resistor તથા approved voltage span પસંદ કરીને worst-case I,P ગણો.
  2. Source isolated રાખીને circuit assemble કરો અને supervisor connection check લો.
  3. Correct sockets/modes તથા safe initial source/current limit ગોઠવો.
  4. Approval પછી જ energise કરીને permitted spanમાં actual V,I pairs લો.
  5. Heating જુઓ અને approved cooling આપો.Desired graph મેળવવા current જબરદસ્તી ન વધારો.
  6. Power isolate કરીને V versus I plot કરો અને slope/R ratios measurement limitsમાં compare કરો.

body.en:
Aim

Select the correct meter configuration for three different quantities.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.

Connections and terminal roles

Voltage:parallel.Current:series.Resistance:isolated,de-energised sample.Never treat these as interchangeable socket connections.

Supervised procedure

  1. Read the meter manual,rating,socket/fuse details and expected circuit values.
  2. With power off,choose voltage mode and connect across the target nodes.
  3. Obtain approval,measure DC voltage and isolate before rewiring.
  4. Configure current mode/socket in the isolated series branch;recheck before energising and recording current.
  5. Isolate all sources and stored energy,then measure the resistor outside influencing parallel paths.
  6. Return leads to the normal voltage sockets and document readings with units/ranges.

Observation table — blank

Quantityconnectionrangeactual readingunituncertainty
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Cross-check measured V/I against isolated R where the same resistor state is assumed.Meter loading/contact error can cause differences.

Fault finding

  • Overrange:stop and select an appropriate rated range after isolation.
  • Blown current fuse:stop and use approved replacement/service;do not bypass the fuse.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.

હેતુ

ત્રણ જુદી quantities માટે correct meter configuration પસંદ કરો.

Instruments અને પસંદગી

  • Intact leads,fuse તથા correct V/ohm/current socketsવાળું DMM લો.Manual limitsમાં expected value કરતાં યોગ્ય મોટી range પસંદ કરો.
  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.

Connections અને Terminals

Voltage માટે parallel,current માટે series અને resistance માટે isolated de-energised sample લો.Sockets/connections interchangeable નથી.

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. Manual,rating,socket/fuse details તથા expected values વાંચો.
  2. Power off રાખીને voltage modeમાં target nodes ઉપર connect કરો.
  3. Approvalથી DC voltage માપો અને rewiring પહેલાં isolate કરો.
  4. Isolated series branchમાં current mode/socket ગોઠવો.Recheck પછી energise કરીને current નોંધો.
  5. બધી sources/stored energy isolate કરીને influencing parallel pathsથી અલગ resistor માપો.
  6. Leadsને normal voltage socketsમાં પાછા મૂકો અને units/ranges સાથે readings નોંધો.

Calculation અને Conclusion

Same resistor stateમાં measured V/Iને isolated R સામે check કરો.Meter loading/contact errorથી ફરક હોઈ શકે છે.

ખામીની તપાસ

  • Overrange થાય તો stop કરીને isolation પછી appropriate rated range લો.
  • Current fuse blown હોય તો approved service/replacement લો;fuse bypass ન કરો.
